يغتصبوا (form VIII)
# يَغْتَصِبُوا (yaḡtaṣibū) /jaɣ.ta.sˤi.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# يُغْتَصَبُوا (yuḡtaṣabū) /juɣ.ta.sˤa.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
